relationship: parents; Spanish at home, so greeting, quote and closing in Spanish, body in English

quote.text: Es de bien nacidos ser agradecidos.
quote.translation: Being grateful is the mark of a noble heart.

body: I keep thinking about the kitchen table. Every school night, Mamá, you sat beside me with my homework until it made sense, and Papá, on the nights you got home late, you left the light on and two cups of hot chocolate waiting.
That table is where I learned that being stuck isn't the same as being lost. I still believe it, and it has carried me further than you know.
Now I'm the one at the kitchen table with Sofía's homework, the way you sat with me. Every time she finally gets it, I think of you both.
Gracias por todo, por la paciencia y por esa luz encendida.

photo.caption: The kitchen table, school nights
photo.alt: Pencil sketch of a kitchen table under a hanging lamp, with two cups and an open notebook and pencil

fun_fact.text: Fun fact: "companion" comes from the Latin for someone you share bread with. Thank you for all the bread, and all the company.
fun_fact.source: Standard etymological dictionaries: companion, from Latin com- + panis
